methods.modelSample: Three world seeds, one decision epoch; report raw paired outcomes and means, no inferential superiority claim.
methods.rules: 24 additional seeds × 4 physical regimes; deterministic rule-only invariant sweep. These do not increase the model sample size.
methods.reuse: Counterfactual regimes and replacement sweeps replay the same model cards. Their attribution is not additional inference or independent statistical replication.
